messages:
emma-partners: Quick heads-up — we're proposing a small breaking change in Partner API v3: rename top-level response field `result` -> `outputs`. This touches SDKs, marketplace adapters, and a handful of SI integrations. Looking for engineering impact assessment + partner comms runway. (2398765432)
raj-engineering: Thanks. Can you list known consumers? my initial thought: SDKs (py/js/go), marketplace ingestion lambda, and 3 integrator SIs that use the webhook payload.
emma-partners: Known: marketplace ingestion, SI A (fintech), SI B (health), internal demo apps. Unknowns: some smaller ISVs — we'll need a partner ping.
mike-ps: Timeline ask from GTM: customers need at least 8 weeks notice for any breaking change on marketplace. Can we do opt-in feature flag first? :thinking_face:
alice-qa: From QA side, we'll need schema fixtures + contract tests for each SDK. If feature-flagged, we need canary endpoints to test in prod traffic.
raj-engineering: Implementation plan: add `outputs` alongside `result` for 4 weeks with a deprecation header, then start returning only `outputs` after week 8. We'll add a compatibility header `X-Redwood-Compat: result-deprecated` for requests hitting the old shape.
sasha-legal: Partners on marketplace — any change that affects signing or verification needs updated T&Cs? This is just a field rename in payload, not crypto. Confirm no signature format change.
emma-partners: No signature change. However, Marketplace ingestion Lambda and SI webhooks rely on exact JSON shapes — need to coordinate doc + patch releases.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: add-outputs-field canary -> prod at 2026-05-04T18:00Z (build #4521) :rocket:
raj-engineering: Canary plan: route 1% of partner traffic to canary for 7 days, run schema fuzzer, and collect SDK error rates. If <0.1% error delta, increase to 10% for next 7 days. Rollback if >1% error delta.
mike-ps: Partner comms: propose sequence: 1) private notice to impacted SIs and marketplace vendors (day 0), 2) SDK patch release with dual-field parsing (day 7), 3) public deprecation notice (day 14), 4) enforcement (day 56).
emma-partners: Sounds good. Can someone own the private notices? I'll draft templates.
alice-qa: Test checklist for SDKs: - accept both `result` and `outputs`, - roundtrip serialization tests, - contract tests against canary endpoint, - CI gating for SDK release.
sasha-legal: Approving comms template for marketplace vendors as long as we include rollback window and support SLA. Please CC legal on the first batch.
raj-engineering: Code snippet for SDK entitlement parsing (we'll add to release notes):
```python
# tolerant parser
def parse_response(payload):
    return payload.get('outputs') or payload.get('result')
```
emma-partners: Draft private notice: "We will introduce `outputs` in API v3 responses. For 4 weeks both `result` and `outputs` will be present. After 8 weeks `result` will be removed. Please update parsers to prefer `outputs`. Full SDK patches and migration guide will be provided."
mike-ps: Add call-to-action: request partner to opt into canary by sharing an example webhook URL + test token before canary start. That speeds validation.
raj-engineering: Ops: we'll expose a header `X-Redwood-Compat: deprecated=result` in canary responses. Also emitting metric `partner.api.v3.result_deprecation.errors` for any parsing failures.
alice-qa: I'll create contract tests that hit the `canary.redwood.example/v3/` endpoint and validate both shapes. Tagging QA ticket RW-998.
sasha-legal: Also include a binding date and an exception escalation path in the notice. I'll draft the brief legal paragraph.
emma-partners: Owners: Emma (partner comms), Raj (engineering rollout), Alice (QA tests), Mike (partner outreach & schedule), Sasha (legal sign-off). Deliverables: 1) draft private notice by EOD tomorrow (2398765510), 2) SDK dual-field patch by EOD +7 (2398766032), 3) canary start (deploy-bot scheduled) 2026-05-04.
raj-engineering: I'll open an internal RFC with the rollout config and include the fallback shim. ETA for PR: 48h.
emma-partners: Thanks — please ping me when PR is merged so I can send notices. Also, prepare FAQ: "Why rename?" "What's the migration cost?" 
mike-ps: I'll prep partner-facing FAQ and a one-pager for marketplace ops.
deploy-bot: canary started: add-outputs-field canary -> 1% traffic (2026-05-04T18:02Z) :white_check_mark: (event ts 2398765650)
raj-engineering: Early canary telemetry: 0.02% parsing errors on SI B due to strict typed models. Rolling a hotfix to SDK adapter for SI B.
emma-partners: Noted. Mike, can you reach SI B and request they enable tolerant parsing this week?
mike-ps: On it. Pinged SI B lead, waiting reply. :email:
alice-qa: Canary contract tests all green for marketplace ingestion lambda. Will run full suite after SI B hotfix.
emma-partners: Ok team — keep updates short here. I'll circulate the private notice once SDK PR lands. :pray:
